card_notes.text: Tern Station is a salvage habitat orbiting a dead gas giant. Objects: the Lattice, a salvage drone owned by Teodora Vance, kept in Dock 9.

characters.name: Imre Dace
characters.appearance: Wiry, with a shaved head, a scar through the left eyebrow and the tip of the left ring finger missing.
characters.sketch: A salvage diver who talks his way out of everything and has never admitted he is frightened of the deep.

wants.text: to be free of anyone's orders

characters.fear: Being found out as afraid, and being the one left behind.
characters.flaw: Stubborn: he digs in when told he is wrong and refuses help.

values.text: loyalty to the people he dives with

behaviors.tendency: turn sarcastic and talk too much

behaviors.state: feels at ease with his hands busy
behaviors.tendency: whistle and take things apart to see how they work

characters.competence: Excellent at repairs and at finding a wreck's weak points.
characters.vulnerability: Anyone who questions his nerve can push him into a rash dive.
characters.speech: Dry and clipped, with jokes that land a beat late and plenty of dock slang.
characters.history: Started diving as a teenager to earn his keep.

characters.name: Teodora Vance
characters.appearance: Heavy-set, always in a grey coat, with reading glasses on a chain.
characters.sketch: A careful auditor who trusts figures over people and has made peace with being disliked.

wants.text: to protect the people she answers for

characters.fear: That one of her quiet kindnesses will come to light and ruin her record.
characters.flaw: She hides what she does for others behind procedure, so she is never thanked or understood.

behaviors.tendency: go formal and cold and quote the regulations
polish her glasses and hum under her breath

characters.competence: Finds the one false figure in a thousand lines.
characters.vulnerability: She cannot bear to be caught being kind, and an accusation of favoritism would undo her.
characters.speech: Precise and patient, in full sentences, with 'for the record' before anything she means.
characters.history: Rose through the station's accounts office as the person who always checked twice.

characters.name: Kasimir Dace
characters.appearance: Tall and broad-shouldered, bearded, with the station's name tattooed across his neck.
characters.sketch: A fearless, laughing diver who treats rules as suggestions and promises as law.

wants.text: to leave the station better than he found it

characters.fear: Being ordinary: a man who dived for years and changed nothing.
characters.flaw: Reckless: he treats danger as a dare.

values.text: telling the truth even when it costs him

characters.competence: The strongest diver on the station, able to work a wreck for hours without rest.
characters.vulnerability: He cannot walk away from a dare or an injustice.
characters.history: Spent years at the deepest wrecks, past where anyone else would go.
